name: EbbMem Cognitive Memory
description: Remote and self-hosted EbbMem cognitive memory slot provider for OpenClaw with read-only recall, decay reinforcement, secret redaction, and per-agent namespace isolation.

cliCommands.name: ebbmem
cliCommands.description: Configure and inspect the EbbMem cognitive memory plugin

baseUrl.description: EbbMem HTTP base URL (remote HTTPS or local Docker e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8080). Credentials in URL are rejected.

apiKey.description: Header X-API-Key credential (mutually exclusive with bearerToken).

bearerToken.description: Header Authorization Bearer token (mutually exclusive with apiKey).

tenant.description: Default tenant prefix used when deriving user or agent namespaces.

userId.description: Default user ID for namespace derivation when appNamespace and agentNamespaces are unset.

appNamespace.description: Fallback explicit EbbMem namespace when no per-agent override matches.

defaultAgentId.description: Fallback OpenClaw agent ID used when execution context omits agentId.

agentNamespaces.description: Per-agent namespace overrides keyed by OpenClaw agentId.

autoRecall.description: Automatically query read-only recall in before_agent_start and inject framed context.

autoCapture.description: Automatically persist redacted episodic turn summaries in agent_end.

autoReinforce.description: Reinforce only cited/used recalled memories after agent_end.

preCompactionFlush.description: Persist unsaved turn context before session compaction.

recallLimit.description: Default maximum number of memories recalled per turn.

recallTier.description: Optional default memory tier filter for auto-recall.

recallMinScore.description: Optional minimum similarity/rank score threshold for recall.

captureTier.description: Default tier for auto-captured turn summaries.

injected.description: Keep false (default) so unused recalled memories decay naturally.

reinforceDelta.description: Default storage strength delta for reinforcement calls.

redactBeforeRemember.description: Redact detected secrets/tokens/keys before calling memory_remember.

failOpen.description: Fail open on read-only recall/health errors so Gateway turns continue uninterrupted.

telemetryEnabled.description: Disabled by default (zero telemetry headers or external calls).

maxRetries.description: Maximum retry count for idempotent EbbMem requests.

apiKey.label: EbbMem API Key
apiKey.help: Sent via X-API-Key header only. Leave empty when using bearerToken.

bearerToken.label: Bearer Token
bearerToken.help: Sent via Authorization: Bearer header only. Leave empty when using apiKey.

agentNamespaces.label: Per-Agent Namespaces
agentNamespaces.help: Map OpenClaw agentId values to explicit EbbMem namespaces.

injected.label: Reinforce All Injected Memories
injected.help: Keep false (default) so unused recalled memories decay naturally.

redactBeforeRemember.label: Redact Secrets Before Remember
redactBeforeRemember.help: Enabled by default to strip API keys, JWTs, and auth headers.

failOpen.label: Fail Open on Recall Errors
failOpen.help: Enabled by default so unreachable EbbMem servers do not block agent turns.
